title: No dejar de + infinitivo: un proceso que no se detiene

sections.content: No dejar de + infinitive (to not stop doing something, to keep on doing it) stresses that a process ran continuously, without pause, across the whole period being described -- the natural way to narrate a migration wave that didn't just happen once but kept happening, decade after decade. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Las nuevas fábricas no dejaron de atraer, década tras década, a millones de campesinos que abandonaban el campo.
items.english: The new factories kept attracting, decade after decade, millions of peasants leaving the countryside.

items.spanish: Ciudades como São Paulo, Ciudad de México y Buenos Aires no dejaron de crecer a un ritmo verdaderamente vertiginoso.
items.english: Cities like São Paulo, Mexico City and Buenos Aires kept growing at a truly dizzying pace.

items.spanish: Las ciudades receptoras no dejaron de enfrentar una contradicción fundamental entre infraestructura y crecimiento poblacional.
items.english: Receiving cities kept facing a fundamental contradiction between infrastructure and population growth.

items.spanish: Esta migración masiva no dejaría de transformar el propio rostro demográfico de la región.
items.english: This massive migration would keep transforming the region's very demographic face.

sections.content: No dejar de + infinitive is a double negative that reads as a strong positive -- "didn't stop doing" means "kept doing, continuously" -- so translate it as an ongoing action, never literally as an interruption.
